detail: Artifact của "protocol-2026-09-10.1-primary-strategies-hot-8e26f348" có protocolHash 9b864bec07e3… nhưng registry ghi 089e16b90b1d….
justification: Root cause found and fixed in Round 4: scripts/run-experiment.ts used to rebuild and overwrite EVERY strategy's artifact file on EVERY run using CURRENT_PROTOCOL's then-current hash, even for experimentIds already frozen in the append-only registry. This experiment was registered on 2026-09-11T18:06:36Z under protocolHash 089e16b90b1d... (now documented in reports/protocol-history.json); a later run (after CURRENT_PROTOCOL's content changed, still under the same unbumped version string 2026-09-10.1) silently overwrote its artifact with the new hash 9b864bec07e3.... Both the registry line and the artifact file are independently append-only/immutable by this project's own rules, so neither is rewritten to hide this — this exception documents the disagreement honestly instead. The fix (run-experiment.ts now only ever writes an artifact the first time its experimentId is registered, refusing to touch it again) has been verified live: re-running npm run research:experiment now correctly no-ops for all 3 of these ids and leaves their artifact files byte-identical.
